analysis: The method onTimelineChanged is called when timeline changes. It first checks progressState and returns if not waiting. Then it creates a new Timeline.Window object and calls timeline.getWindow(0, window). This may throw IndexOutOfBoundsException if timeline has no window at index 0. Also, it accesses window.isPlaceholder and window.durationUs, which should be safe. Then it calls assetLoaderListener.onDurationUs, which could throw NullPointerException if assetLoaderListener is null. Both are runtime exceptions. These exceptions would crash the app if unhandled, so exception handling is advisable.
